brief: Street sitters get up when the sky thickens — they refuse a seat above weatherComing() 0.42 and are released over 0.55..0.88 off a per-agent a.wary. Courtyard sitters, the picnic pairs on the lawn and the people on the benches, sit through the rain, because the gate at the sit branch reads a.street. This is c11, open since #5, and the reason it stayed open was that a courtyard sit is assigned at a waypoint with no route left, so refusing it would despawn somebody mid-lawn. routeToExit(a) now exists. Close it.
successLooksLike: A front building over the courtyard empties the lawn and the benches at the same staggered per-person rate the cafe tables already empty at, and nobody vanishes where they sat.
avoid: Do not give courtyard sitters umbrellas by default — the ~30% who get caught out is a deliberate reading. A picnic pair arrives together and shares a blanket, so do not let one half leave without the other.
